policies.summary: Merit scholarships covering 25% to 100% of tuition fees are awarded to students maintaining a CGPA of 8.5 and above with no backlogs.
policies.details: Evaluation happens at the end of each academic year in July. Top 5% of students in each department receive Dean's Merit Scholarship. Minimum attendance of 80% and clean disciplinary record are mandatory eligibility criteria.
policies.actionable: Eligible candidates are auto-shortlisted; inquiries on disbursement status can be routed to Financial Aid Cell.

policies.topic: Government and State Scholarship Portal Verification
policies.summary: State/National Scholarship Portal (NSP) applications require institute nodal officer verification within 15 days of online submission.
policies.details: Students must submit hard copies of income certificate, community certificate, and fee receipt at Counter #5. Institutional verification is completed within 3 working days of document receipt.
policies.actionable: Submit physical attested documents at the Scholarship Cell for portal verification clearance.
